headline: Ravens OLB Trey Hendrickson Undergoes Finger Surgery, Will Miss Week 4
summary: The Ravens will go without star pass rusher Trey Hendrickson against the Titans on Sunday. Head coach Jesse Minter announced Hendrickson underwent finger surgery, adding that the outside linebacker’s absence should be “very, very short term” (via Jamison Hensley of ESPN). Hendrickson broke his finger in the Ravens’ 41-23 win in Indianapolis in Week 1. […]

headline: Vikings' Justin Jefferson out vs. Dolphins with ankle injury
summary: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson won't play against the Dolphins because of a sprained left ankle, but coach Kevin O'Connell is hopeful he can return in Week 5 vs. the Saints.

headline: Aaron Donald out, Puka Nacua to play in Rams' game vs. Eagles
summary: Rams defensive tackle Aaron Donald will not play against the Eagles as he deals with back soreness, while wide receiver Puka Nacua will return from a hip injury after missing the past two games.
